items.title: International Business Machines (IBM) Faces Probe Over Z Mainframe Disclosure Risks
items.summary: Hagens Berman Sobol Shapiro LLP has launched a material investigation into International Business Machines (NYSE:IBM) over disclosures tied to its Z mainframe segment. The probe centers on whether IBM adequately informed investors about risks connected to a significant revenue shortfall in its Z mainframe business. items.title: How Much Downside Is Left In Accenture Stock?
items.summary: Accenture (ACN) stock still trades 53% below its high from before the 2025 tariff shock. The shares slipped 5.1% over the past month with no new results. items.title: Is IBM Stock A Real Bargain?
items.summary: International Business Machines (IBM) stock trades at 19.9 times the past year's earnings. The median S&P 500 company trades at 22.1 times. The shares lost 14.4% over the last twelve months, while the S&P 500 returned 17.1%. Is IBM a good business on sale, or a fair price for one whose growth has stalled? The answer starts with what the price buys you today.
